messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate & throttles for org=\"stratagem-org\". 4.2k qps sustained, 503/524s rising to 32%. Auto-created incident INC-2026-2443. Link: https://redwood.ops/inc/INC-2026-2443

oncall-anna: acked. I’m pulling request logs and recent routing changes now.

eng-sre-jay: seeing spike correlated with /v1/embeddings/batch endpoint, big tail on seq lengths. p95 latency ~1200ms, backend GPU pool saturating. Some requests getting queued -> upstream 524s.

infra-ops-lee: I can do a targeted org-level rate tweak. Suggest temp bump to 2500 qps and enable org-specific queue-depth cap to avoid node OOMs.

oncall-anna: +1 to Lee. Plan: (1) apply temp qps bump 30m, (2) toggle non-essential features (reranker/long-ctx), (3) route heavy embedding flows to batch-cooldown.

eng-sre-jay: running mitigation steps now. Will also enable fallback model variant (small-quantized rosette-quant) for non-critical routes to reduce GPU memory + latency.

infra-ops-lee: executing command:```
apply-rl-adjust --org stratagem-org --qps 2500 --duration 30m --reason \"emergency spike: embeddings burst\"
```

incident-bot: apply-rl-adjust succeeded for stratagem-org. new org qps=2500 until 2026-09-16T15:41:23Z.

oncall-anna: confirmed immediate error-rate drop from 32% -> 8% in the past 90s. p95 down to ~420ms. Good.

eng-sre-jay: also toggled feature flag:```
ff-toggle --org stratagem-org --flag stratagem_re_ranker --off --note \"emergency disable to reduce tail latency\"
```

customer-success-maya: drafting customer note to stratagem support: \"We observed a large spike affecting embedding throughput; we've applied a short-term service-level adjustment and disabled a non-critical feature to stabilize traffic. Expect improved latency; we'll follow up with root cause and timeline for permanent changes.\" Want review before send.

product-oliver: 👍 keep it calm and explain short-term nature. Add guidance: retry after 10s backoff, and mention we’ll share post-incident alert.

eng-sre-jay: also applying a transient traffic-shaper rule to cap concurrent embedding batches per org to 8:```
traffic-shaper set --org stratagem-org --endpoint /v1/embeddings/batch --concurrency 8 --duration 30m
```

infra-ops-lee: traffic-shaper applied. No node restarts required. CPU/GPU utilization trending down.

incident-bot: Pager handoff reminder: oncall-anna -> day-oncall (sam) at 08:00 UTC. Handoff marker created.

oncall-anna: handing to Sam with context: temp qps bump applied, reranker off, fallback model active, concurrency capped. Follow-up items: (a) run evals on fallback quality, (b) investigate client-side burst pattern and batching size, (c) propose permanent quota change if this becomes steady.

customer-success-maya: sent initial message to customer; they acknowledged and asked for ETA on full restore. I told them we'll follow up within 2 hours with RCA-ish update.

product-oliver: file follow-ups in INC-2026-2443: ownership - eng-sre-jay for root cause, infra-ops-lee for mitigation hardening, cs-maya for customer comms. Recommend postmortem and quota policy review.

eng-sre-jay: will keep monitoring for 30m window, then revert bump if stable. Creating a small eval harness to compare rosette-quant vs prod model on quality metrics.

oncall-anna: closing live mitigation loop here. If error-rate rises again, re-open and escalate. Moving thread to incident channel and doing handoff notes. :white_check_mark:
